selection: Sol_A fixed in each case before calls; no replacement by Sol_B or another model
only_experimental_difference: feedback arm additionally receives own-generated diagnostic observations; ordinary second-look does not
diagnostic_payload: Recorded schema/execution status, per-seed requested estimates, SDs, physical component counts and raw availability; no source replay assertion, target reference, desired values, other candidates or solutions
diagnostic_scope: generated task population, not a simulated source cohort or actual target observations
review_failure_policy: retain frozen initial as delivered workflow product, explicitly mark retained_review_failed; no replacement calls
initial_failure_policy: parent and both branch products unavailable; skip branch requests; retain every scheduled outcome
unchanged_review_policy: retain parent scientific artifact, retain returned decision record in captured review; do not call reporting change a new data law
primary_readout: per-parent change and between-branch contrast in physical component violation fraction on fresh evaluation seeds; delivery availability is reported jointly
clinical_reference_scope: same previously exposed aggregate references; developmental analysis only after all generated outputs close
statistics: two paired parents; per-case descriptive results, no pooled cross-unit score, no significance or equivalence claim
stopping: one bounded split review per fixed parent; no extra cases, seeds, authors or target-guided modifications
